---
name: release-pr-preparation
description: Prepare capstone-compliant PR description, changelog, test evidence, limitations, and reviewer checklist.
---

# Release / PR Preparation Skill
- Confirm QA evidence and review finding status.
- Verify branch, diff, and working tree; exclude secrets, logs, and unrelated changes.
- Draft all required PR sections: Summary, Changes Made, Test Evidence, Known Limitations, Reviewer Checklist.
- Include actual test commands/results and CI links only when available.
- Prepare a changelog entry consistent with repository conventions.
- Request explicit human approval before PR creation or push.
- Never claim a PR exists until the tool confirms it.
